name: Placid Dilettante
text:
Activates in hand. Whenever you Engage a Clue amulet, swap this follower's attack and defense and give it +1/+0.

Fanfare: Summon 2 copies of Guileless Newsie and set their attack and defense to X/Y. X and Y are this follower's attack and defense.

Evolve: Give all other allied followers on the field Bane.
